master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: How would I go about getting a Master Thief armband?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Ooh... tricky stuff. Took me YEARS to get that rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Well, what some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: His security is excellent, and the target very valuable so that might be enough to get you the rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Go talk to our man Alfonse, the waiter in the Shrimp and Parrot.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Use the secret word 'gherkin' to show you're one of us.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: You told me you wanted to get a Master thief's armband! Now pay attention.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: His security is excellent, and the target very valuable so that might be enough to get you the rank.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Go talk to our man Alfonse, the waiter in the Shrimp and Parrot.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Use the secret word 'gherkin' to show you're one of us.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-tryi.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-tryi.text: Hey! You can't go through there! That's private property!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, sir?

options.text: Yes please.
No thank you.
Do you sell Gherkins?

steps.player: Do you sell Gherkins?

steps.speaker: Alfonse the waiter
steps.text: Hmmmm Gherkins eh? Ask Charlie the cook, round the back. He may have some 'gherkins' for you!
Alfonse winks at you.

options.text: Where do you get your Karambwan from?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Charlie the cook
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Hey! What are you doing back here?

options.text: I'm looking for a gherkin...

steps.player: I'm looking for a gherkin...

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Aaaaaah... a fellow Phoenix! So, tell me compadre... what brings you to sunny Brimhaven?

options.text: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!

steps.player: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Well, can't say I blame you compadre. I used to be a city boy myself, but have to admit it's a lot nicer living here nowadays. Brimhaven's certainly good for it.

options.text: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.player: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Ah yes, of course. The candlesticks. Well, I have to be honest with you compadre, we haven't made much progress in that task ourselves so far. We can however offer

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: a little assistance. The setting up of this restaurant was the start of things; we have a secret door out the back of here that leads through the back of Mr Olbors' garden.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Now, at the other side of Mr Olbors' garden, is an old side entrance to Scarface Pete's mansion. It seems to have been blocked off from the rest of the mansion some years ago

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: and we can't seem to find a way through. We're positive this is the key to entering the house undetected however, and I promise to let you know if we find anything there.

steps.player: Mind if I check it out for myself?

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Not at all! The more minds we have working on the problem, the quicker we get that loot!

options.text: I'm a fellow member of the Phoenix gang.

steps.player: I'm a fellow member of the Phoenix gang.

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Aaaaaah... a fellow Phoenix! So, tell me compadre... what brings you to sunny Brimhaven?

options.text: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!
I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.
Just exploring...

steps.player: Just exploring...

steps.speaker: Charlie the cook
steps.text: Well get out! This kitchen isn't for exploring! It's a private establishment! It's out of bounds to customers!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.speaker: Garv
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.text: Oi! Where do you think you're going pal?

options.text: Can I go in there?

steps.player: Can I go in there?

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: No. In there is private.

options.text: I want for nothing!

steps.player: I want for nothing!

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: You're one of a very lucky few then.

options.text: Would you like your hedges trimming?

steps.player: Would you like your hedges trimming?

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: Eh? Don't be daft! We don't even HAVE any hedges!

options.text: I want to come in.

steps.player: I want to come in.

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: No, go away.

options.text: Do you want to trade?

steps.player: Do you want to trade?

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: No, I'm busy.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.player: This room isn't a lot of use on its own... Maybe I can get extra help from the inside somehow... I wonder if any of the other players have found a way in.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-atte.text: Well, in all honesty, you didn't actually retrieve it yourself, did you? You don't qualify as a master thief unless you actually steal it yourself, you know...

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.text: Hmmm. Not bad, not bad. Let's see it, make sure it's genuine.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.player: So is this enough to get me a Master Thief armband?

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-hand.text: Aww, go on then. I suppose I'm in a generous mood today.
Straven hands you a Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: I'm afraid I've lost my Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: Lucky for you I have a spare. Don't lose it again!

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.player: I'm afraid I've lost my Master Thief armband.

master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.speaker: Straven
master-thieves-armband-phoenix-gang-talk.text: We shouldn't speak about that now!

options.text: Who are all those people in there?
Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

steps.player: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Master thief? Ain't we the ambitious one!

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, you're gonna have to do something pretty amazing.

steps.player: Anything you can suggest?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, some of the MOST coveted prizes in thiefdom right now are in the pirate town of Brimhaven on Karamja.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: The pirate leader Scarface Pete has a pair of extremely valuable candlesticks.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: His security is VERY good.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: We, of course, have gang members in a town like Brimhaven who may be able to help you.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Visit our hideout in the alleyway on Palm Street. To get in you will need to tell them the secret password 'four leafed clover'.

options.text: Rabbit's foot.
Four leaved clover.

steps.speaker: Grubor
steps.text: Oh, you're one of the gang are you? Ok, hold up a second, I'll just let you in through here.
You hear the door being unbarred from inside.

options.text: Lucky horseshoe.
Black cat.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.speaker: Grubor
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: Hi. I'm a little busy right now.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-tr.speaker: Trobert
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-tr.text: Hi. Welcome to our Brimhaven headquarters. I'm Trobert and I'm in charge here.

options.text: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?

steps.player: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well, we have made some progress there. We know that one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by Grip, the head guard, so we thought it might be good to get close to him somehow.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Grip was taking on a new deputy called Hartigen, an Asgarnian Black Knight who was deserting the Black Knight Fortress and seeking new employment here on Brimhaven.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: We managed to waylay him on the journey here, and steal his I.D. papers. Now all we need is to find somebody willing to impersonate him and take the deputy role to get that key for us.

options.text: I volunteer to undertake that mission!

steps.player: I volunteer to undertake that mission!

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Good good. Here's the I.D. papers. Take them and introduce yourself to the guards at Scarface Pete's mansion. We'll have that treasure in no time.

options.text: Well, good luck then.

steps.player: Well, good luck then.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Someone will show up eventually.

options.text: Pleased to meet you.

steps.player: Pleased to meet you.

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Likewise.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has the ID papers:

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: How's it going?

steps.player: Fine, thanks.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has lost the ID papers:

steps.player: I have lost Hartigen's ID paper...

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well that was careless of you wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with this one.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ta.text: If the player has lost the ID papers and has a full inventory:

steps.player: I have lost Hartigen's ID papers...

steps.speaker: Trobert
steps.text: Well that was careless of you, wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare set. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with it.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: Trying to enter the mansion rather than talking to Garv

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Oi! Where do you think you're going pal?

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Hello. What do you want?

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.player: Hi. I'm Hartigen. I've come to work here.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: If the player is not wearing black armour:

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: Hartigen the Black Knight? I don't think so. He doesn't dress like that.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-in.text: If the player is wearing black armour:

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: I assume you have your I.D. papers then?
If the player has the ID papers

steps.speaker: Garv
steps.text: You'd better come in then. Grip will want to talk to you.
If the player do not have the ID papers

steps.player: Uh... yeeeeaaaaah.... about that.... I must have left them in my other suit of armour....

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.player: Hi there. I am Hartigen. reporting for duty as your new deputy sir!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.speaker: Grip
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: Ah good, at last. You took your time getting here! Now let me see...

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.speaker: Grip
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: I'll get your hours and duty roster sorted out in a while. Oh, and do you have your I.D. papers with you? Internal security is almost as important as external security for a guard.
If the player has the ID papers

steps.player: Right here sir!

steps.text: You hand the ID papers over to Grip.

options.text: So can I guard the treasure room please?

steps.player: So can I guard the treasure room please?

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Well, I might post you outside it sometimes. I prefer to be the only one allowed inside however.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: There's some pretty valuable artefacts in there! Those keys stay ONLY with the head guard and Scarface Pete.

options.text: So what do my duties involve?

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: You'll have various guard related duties on various shifts. I'll assign specific duties as they are required as and when they become necessary. Just so you know, if anything happens to me

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: you'll need to take over as head guard here. You'll find important keys to the treasure room and Pete's quarters inside my jacket - although I doubt anything bad's going to happen to

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: me anytime soon!
Grip laughs to himself at the thought.

options.text: So can I guard the treasure room please?
Well, I'd better sort my new room out.
Anything I can do now?

steps.player: Anything I can do now?

steps.text: If the player does not have a miscellaneous key yet:

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Hmm. Well, you could find out what this key opens for me. Apparently it's for something in this building, but for the life of me I can't find what.
Grip hands you a key.
a miscellaneous key
If the player has a miscellaneous key already:

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Can't think of anything right now.

options.text: Well, I'd better sort my new room out.

steps.player: Well, I'd better sort my new room out.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Yeah, I'll give you time to settle in. Better get a good nights sleep, I expect you to report for duty at oh five hundred hours tomorrow on the dot!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-re.text: If the player lost the ID papers

steps.player: Oh dear... I don't have that with me anymore..

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Well that's no good! Go get them immediately, then report back for duty.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.player: I can't attack the head guard here! There are too many witnesses around to see me do it! I'd have the whole of Brimhaven after me! Besides, if he dies I want the promotion!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: Perhaps you need another player's help...?
If Grip is alive and any of the pirate guards are nearby

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.speaker: Pirate Guard
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.

options.text: He won't notice me having a quick look.

steps.player: He won't notice me having a quick look.

steps.speaker: Grip
steps.text: Stay out of my drinks cabinet!

options.text: Ok, I'll leave it.

steps.player: Ok, I'll leave it.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-wh.text: If there's no one to stop you:

steps.text: You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
whisky

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-se.text: You find two candlesticks in the chest. So that will be one for you, and one for the person who killed Grip for you.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-at.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-at.text: I'll be giving a master thieves armband to the one who retrieved that. I know it wasn't you.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: This really is a FINE bit of thievery.

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: Us thieves have been trying to get hold of this one for a while!

master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.speaker: Katrine
master-thieves-armband-black-arm-gang-ha.text: You wanted to be ranked as a master thief didn't you? Well, I guess this just about ranks as good enough!
Katrine gives you a master thief armband.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.player: Hello, I am in search of an Entranan Firebird. Can you help me?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.speaker: Monk
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.text: Oh ho! Another one! I don't think they exist, but you'd probably ask the head monk about it. If anyone would know, he would!

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.speaker: Monk
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-a-mo.text: Anything else you wanted to know?

options.text: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out the way

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.player: Hello, I am in search of an Entranan Firebird. Can you help me?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Well adventurer, I have heard that they exist on this island, but have not ever seen one myself.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: According to legend however, they are so hot that their merest touch can burn flesh.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: Apparently long ago a great hero used a pair of magical gloves, stolen from the Queen of the Ice to cool the bird down enough to catch as a pet.

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.player: So where would I find this 'Queen of the Ice' then?

entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.speaker: High Priest
entrana-firebird-feather-talking-to-the-.text: I know not adventurer, it was just a myth I was told as a young boy. Perhaps somewhere icy?

entrana-firebird-feather-investigating-t.text: These rocks contain nothing interesting. They are just in the way.

entrana-firebird-feather-attempting-to-p.text: It is too hot to take. You need something cold to pick it up with.

cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant.speaker: Gerrant
cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant.text: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.

options.text: Let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.player: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
Gerrant searches around a bit.
Blamish snail slime

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.

cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant-again.speaker: Gerrant
cooked-lava-eel-talking-to-gerrant-again.text: Welcome! You can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also buy anything you catch off you.

options.text: Let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.player: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

steps.speaker: Gerrant
steps.text: You'll need a lava-proof fishing line. I'm sure I already gave you what you need for this - take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.text: You mix the slime into your potion.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.player: You know... I'd really rather not.

cooked-lava-eel-making-an-oily-fishing-r.text: You rub the oil into the fishing rod.

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.text: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.player: I have a raw Lava Eel!

handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-trying-to-hand-in-a.text: That's nice. I require it to be cooked however.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.player: I have all the required items.

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: I see that you have. Well done; Now, to complete the quest, and gain entry to the Heroes' Guild in your final task all that you have to do is...

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.player: W-what? What do you mean? There's MORE???

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: I'm sorry, I was just having a little fun with you. Just a little Heroes' Guild humour there. What I really meant was

handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.speaker: Achietties
handing-in-the-items-speaking-to-achiett.text: Congratulations! You have completed the Heroes' Guild entry requirements! You will find the door now open for you! Enter, Hero! And take this reward!

6FQuQb.speaker: Grubor
6FQuQb.text: Eh? What are you on about? Go away!
